assets.explanation: This asset is nothing like the references on this board. Its distance from the board is 0.715, while the most unusual reference on the board sits at 0.271 and the line for a far outlier is 0.305. Comparing it with these references would produce a number without a meaning, so no score is given.

comparisons.note: 10 pairs were compared: every pair of scored assets sharing a category. Two assets are tied when the interval around their paired score difference, computed over shared leave-one-out folds, contains zero. Marginal-interval overlap is not the test and cannot define groups, because the relation is not transitive.
